examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!
That was very bad vodka, Samson.

всякий.gloss: every kind of, all sorts of, any

meanings.en: all sorts of, every kind of
meanings.note: всякое бывает = all sorts of things happen
На всякий случай = just in case.

examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen.
Take an umbrella just in case.

examples.text: Ладно, всякое бывает. Ну что вы?
examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen. Oh, come on.

meanings.note: гадости рассказывать = to say nasty things

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.
examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

examples.text: Да, вы знаете, это очень серьёзная операция. Мы всё исправим. До свидания!
examples.trans: Yes, you know, it is a very serious operation. We'll fix everything. Goodbye!

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

наговорить.gloss: to say a lot of (too much)

meanings.en: to say a lot of, blurt out too much
meanings.note: + genitive: наговорить лишнего = to say too much

examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.
He said a lot of foolish things.

examples.text: Что ты про меня наговорил Насте?
examples.trans: What did you tell Nastya about me?

meanings.note: налей мне чаю = pour me some tea; налей мужу = pour your husband a drink

examples.trans: Nina, pour your husband a drink. We've got something to celebrate!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
The mayor came up with a new plan.

examples.text: Но мэр придумал новый план. Сосед мэра теперь пойдёт в мэры.
examples.trans: But the mayor came up with a new plan. The mayor's neighbour will now run for mayor.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?

examples.text: Эдуард Владимирович, я на минуточку. Я спасла монастырь!
examples.trans: Eduard Vladimirovich, I'll only be a minute. I saved the monastery!

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
